name: CourtesyVehicleFleetManager
tagline: Run the dealer loan-car desk in one Power Apps component – availability, check-out, check-in with automatic charges and fleet utilisation.
description: A complete courtesy / loan car app for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: an availability calendar of the whole courtesy fleet with double-booking detection and drag-to-swap, reservations linked to the customer's repair order, check-out with licence, signed agreement, deposit, mileage, fuel or EV charge level and damage walk-round, check-in with live excess-mileage, fuel, late-return and damage charges, settle-or-waive closing, overdue returns, off-road blocks, de-fleet mileage and 30-day utilisation KPIs. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Fleet availability calendar (7/14/21 days) with clash stripes and free-car counts
Drag a reservation to another car or day with clash checks
Check-out: licence, agreement, deposit, mileage, fuel eighths or EV charge %, existing damage
Check-in with live charges: excess mileage, fuel / charge shortfall, late return, damage
Settle or waive charges with a reason
Extend / shorten loans checked against the next reservation
Off-road blocks for service, valet, tyres, recalls
De-fleet mileage and utilisation per vehicle
Overdue, stale, long-loan, paperwork and missing-RO flags
Bulk status / assign / export / delete with undo
Customer reservation message for Outlook, Power Automate or SMS
Phone layout with bottom view bar, day list and column switcher
Power Fx outputs and OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
